config.goal: 修复 gx 路径过滤语义：include 触发按需补索引并覆盖当前 ignore 隐藏，exclude 继续作为查询期排除，普通查询基于当前 ignore 规则实时决定可见性，避免持久化 stale ignored 状态。
config.verify:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/.git" "$tmp/pkg"
cat >"$tmp/.gitignore" <<'"'"'EOG'"'"'
pkg/ignored.go
EOG
cat >"$tmp/pkg/ignored.go" <<'"'"'EOG'"'"'
package pkg
func Hidden() {}
EOG
failures=0
base=$(go run . -C "$tmp" --json symbols --name Hidden . 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ "$base" != "[]" ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi
included=$(go run . -C "$tmp" --json symbols --include "pkg/ignored.go" --name Hidden . 2>/dev/null || true)
case "$included" in *'"'"'"name": "Hidden"'"'"'*) : ;; *) failures=$((failures+1));; esac
: > "$tmp/.gitignore"
visible=$(go run . -C "$tmp" --json symbols --name Hidden . 2>/dev/null || true)
case "$visible" in *'"'"'"name": "Hidden"'"'"'*) : ;; *) failures=$((failures+1));; esac
printf "%s\n" "$failures"'

notes: Current worktree contains a partial incorrect include/exclude implementation; correct it rather than keeping query-only include semantics.
Preserve the existing user change in CLAUDE.md.
original_goal: 修正 gx 的 include/exclude 与 ignore 语义：include 必须能覆盖当前 ignore 规则，把被 ignore 的命中重新纳入；默认查询必须按当前 ignore 规则隐藏；ignore 规则删除后，不带 include 也必须恢复可见。
